patches.change: added an input-adaptation script: wraps me.input.bindKey/unbindKey so the Up arrow mirrors the space bar's action, and re-grabs keyboard focus (window.focus) on load and pointerdown
patches.reason: the game runs in an opaque-origin sandboxed iframe that never takes keyboard focus on its own, so the space bar never reached it; the Up-arrow alias adds a second key for the same one-button flap. No gameplay change; input only.
